mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plt_file_upload_session (id, mode_code, owner_context, object_type, object_id, purpose_code, reference_key, file_name, category_code, declared_size_bytes, declared_media_type, storage_operation_id, status_code, scope_version, expires_at, version, artifact_id, reference_id, expected_reference_version, client_sha256, actual_sha256, completed_file_version_no, registered_infra_file_id, failure_code, failure_detail, completed_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.modeCode}, #{row.ownerContext}, #{row.objectType}, #{row.objectId}, #{row.purposeCode}, #{row.referenceKey}, #{row.fileName}, #{row.categoryCode}, #{row.declaredSizeBytes}, #{row.declaredMediaType}, #{row.storageOperationId}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.scopeVersion}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.version}, #{row.artifactId}, #{row.referenceId}, #{row.expectedReferenceVersion}, #{row.clientSha256}, #{row.actualSha256}, #{row.completedFileVersionNo}, #{row.registeredInfraFileId}, #{row.failureCode}, #{row.failureDetail}, #{row.completedAt}, #{row.creator}, COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.updater}, COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, mode_code, owner_context, object_type, object_id, purpose_code, reference_key, file_name, category_code, declared_size_bytes, declared_media_type, storage_operation_id, status_code, scope_version, expires_at, version, artifact_id, reference_id, expected_reference_version, client_sha256, actual_sha256, completed_file_version_no, registered_infra_file_id, failure_code, failure_detail, completed_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id FROM plt_file_upload_session WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_file_upload_session SET status_code = 'COMPLETED', artifact_id = #{query.artifactId}, reference_id = #{query.referenceId}, actual_sha256 = #{query.actualSha256}, completed_file_version_no = #{query.completedFileVersionNo}, registered_infra_file_id = #{query.registeredInfraFileId}, completed_at = #{query.completedAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.sessionId} AND status_code = 'VALIDATING' AND version = #{query.expectedVersion}
